issue_title: Some rows never appear when paging through a table
issue_body: Stepping through a table one page at a time never reveals the complete set of rows: a few rows are missing entirely. Collecting every page and combining them yields fewer rows than the table actually contains. Tables small enough to fit on a single page are unaffected.
prompt: Stepping through a table one page at a time never reveals the complete set of rows: a few rows are missing entirely. Collecting every page and combining them yields fewer rows than the table actually contains. Tables small enough to fit on a single page are unaffected.
expected_behavior: Every row appears exactly once when browsing all pages sequentially.
The total row count across all pages matches the table row count.
The next-page link on each page points to the correct continuation position.
Unfiltered and filtered table pagination behave consistently.
